goal: Cross-Platform Linux VPS Support, Silent Automatic Background Restart Resumption, and Resumable Progression (20% -> 21%)
acceptanceCriteria: 1. Linux VPS / Ubuntu Support: Provide headless CLI, daemon mode, POSIX permissions, directory-based FUSE mounts (omitting Windows-only WinFsp flags), and XDG directory resolution.

2. Silent Automatic Background Restart Resumption: Eliminate notifications asking user to drag-and-drop again on restart. System automatically fetches and resumes interrupted transfers silently in the background.

3. Resumable Progression (20% -> 21%): Checks cloud storage first; skipped files retain confirmed progress so batches start at 20% and advance to 21%+ rather than resetting to 0%. Large files utilize chunked resumable flags (--drive-chunk-size 32M) and --ignore-existing.
4. Headless Linux Entrypoint: Implement src/cli/nsclouddrive.ps1, scripts/nsclouddrive bash wrapper, systemd service (scripts/systemd/nsclouddrive.service), and scripts/install-linux.sh.
5. Unified Release Packaging: Package-Release.ps1 creates both Windows zip (NSCloudDrive-v2.0.0-Windows-x64.zip) and Linux tarball (NSCloudDrive-v2.0.0-Linux-x64.tar.gz) with SHA-256 checksums.
6. Verification: Automated test suites (Test-LinuxCrossPlatformSupport.ps1, Test-PostRestartDropDeduplication.ps1, Test-TransferRecoveryAndProgression.ps1, etc.) pass with exit code 0.

decisions.decision: Implement cross-platform XDG data and config root resolution in ConnectionState.ps1 with fallback to LocalAppData on Windows.
decisions.rationale: Enables completely native headless operation on Linux VPS without throwing Windows-specific path errors.

decisions.decision: Support directory mount targets and Linux FUSE in VirtualDriveManager.ps1 while omitting WinFsp flags (--network-mode, --fuse-flag --ThreadCount=64, --fuse-flag --FileSystemName=NTFS).
decisions.rationale: Prevents rclone crash on Linux where WinFsp-specific flags are unrecognized by Linux kernel FUSE.

decisions.decision: Remove interactive drag-and-drop prompt notifications on startup; automatically resume background transfer queue processing silently.
decisions.rationale: Fulfills user requirement for completely automated unattended sync across system and PC restarts.

decisions.decision: Build unified dual-distribution packaging (Windows zip and Linux tar.gz with SHA-256) in scripts/Package-Release.ps1.
decisions.rationale: Allows simultaneous publishing and deployment across Windows desktop and Linux VPS platforms.

reviewFindings.notes: Audited strict mode safety, POSIX ACL compatibility, non-blocking UI dispatcher, and granular 1:1 commit compliance. All tests passed with exit code 0.
